summary: This bill allows individuals transitioning from Department of Defense to Department of Veterans Affairs mental health care to continue treatment with their existing Department of Defense provider, with the VA reimbursing the DOD for these services.

scores.thoughts: This bill allows individuals transitioning from DoD to VA care to retain their DoD mental health provider and requires the VA to reimburse the DoD for these services. This directly impacts the operations and funding of military medical treatment facilities, thus affecting military spending.
